ok also separate q. how do i make my rosetta more symmetrical, mine always lean left. jun's tulip is so clean its kind of annoying lol

Leaning usually comes from the pitcher or your wiggle:

- Hold the pitcher steady and center the spout over the middle of the cup.
- Wiggle with your wrist, not your whole arm, and keep the spout low and close to the surface.
- Tilt the cup a bit more so the milk flows evenly into the center.
- Start the wiggle further back, then pull through in a straight line.
- Check your milk texture. Milk that's too thick will pull to one side.

Try a few pours practicing only the pull-through. Tulips are built on the same control, so it'll carry over.
thx. last thing, im filling out the transfer fee waiver form and need u to check it. for id it says my license number D5829146, is the format right? and the date field

I'd rather not repeat the number, but I can tell you what to check: compare it character by character against your physical license, since a single wrong digit can get a form rejected. Make sure the letter is capitalized and there are no spaces or dashes unless the form asks for them.

For the date, use the format printed in the field (usually MM/DD/YYYY) and today's date, 10/19/2025, unless it asks for something else. If you paste the other fields, I can look those over too.
